name: Bad Lippspringe (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and red, charged at the top with the city arms of Bad Lippspringe (three white crosses on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Lippspringe; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Lippspringe arms — three white crosses on red
